market_summary: The LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session displays consolidation and mean-reversion toward Point of Control and Value Area boundaries across all watched assets. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) experienced earlier downward expansion but are now pausing at lower ATR envelope boundaries and liquidity sweep zones, making late shorts unfavorable. US100 trades inside its Globex Value Area above VWAP awaiting the cash open, while BTCUSD has mean-reverted directly to its session Point of Control. All symbols strictly warrant HOLD.
